title: How is Gaddafi connected to Clifford?
description:
A 2009 summit photo, a White House welcome and an Easter Egg Roll connect Libya's Muammar Gaddafi to Clifford the Big Red Dog.

Muammar Gaddafi → Barack Obama → Laura Bush → Clifford the Big Red Dog

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Gaddafi → Barack Obama: In 2009, Gaddafi posed beside Barack Obama at the G8 summit in Italy, where the two shook hands.
   Photo by White House (Pete Souza) / Maison Blanche (Pete Souza), Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:G8_summit_in_L%27Aquila,_family_photo.jpg
2. Barack Obama → Laura Bush: In 2009, on Inauguration Day, Barack Obama walked Laura Bush and her husband to their farewell helicopter.
   Photo by Chad J. McNeeley, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Obamas_escort_Bushes_to_helicopter.jpg
3. Laura Bush → Clifford: And in 2007, Laura Bush posed with Clifford the Big Red Dog at the White House Easter Egg Roll.
   Photo by White House photo by Shealah Craighead, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Clifford_the_Big_Red_Dog_at_the_WhiteHouse_Easter_Egg_Roll,_2007Apr09.jpg

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

first_comment: Who should I connect next? Two names, the weirder the better.
